items.title: Jerry Jerome interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: looking over the railing at Louie, the drummer, and oh it fascinated me

ctx.x: I’ll just show you where I read that, maybe it’s true. Did you start out as a clarinetist? © Fillius Jazz Archive -2-

I started as a drummer. I was fascinated with drums as a child, you know, in the vaudeville theaters, see the pit drummer that was standing watching everything that was going on, you know he’d hit a ratchet and blow a whistle with a dum-bang, and catch all the kicks and everything, and I said wow, interesting. And I would moved down to a better seat until I’d end up at the fourth show, you know, looking over the railing at Louie, the drummer, and oh it fascinated me and that sound was so crisp. It was just about…
It’s interesting that they even said “C melody.”
